query: Super Micro Computer FY2025 full year revenue
normalized: computer full fy2025 micro revenue super year

output.content: Super Micro Computer’s FY2025 full-year revenue (reported as net sales) was **$21.972 billion** for the fiscal year ended **June 30, 2025**, up from **$14.989 billion** in FY2024. [[1]]

sources.title: UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION Washington, D.C. 20549
